description: This file defines API routes for managing gym membership plans, including creating, listing, updating, deleting, subscribing, canceling, and retrieving current memberships. It uses FastAPI and SQLAlchemy for web routing and database interactions.

methods.name: create_membership_plan
methods.description: Creates a new membership plan, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: update_membership_plan
methods.description: Updates an existing membership plan, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: delete_membership_plan
methods.description: Deletes a membership plan, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the current user to a membership plan, possibly triggering payment.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current user's active membership.

methods.name: current_membership
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's membership details.
